name: zotero-tabflow
description: Unified horizontal & vertical tab grouping, pinned tabs, tab sleep, remarks, sessions, collection auto-grouping, and Spotlight search for Zotero 10-12.

scripts.build: npm run build:bundle && npm run guard && npm run build:xpi
scripts.test:syntax: node --check bootstrap.js && node --check zoterotabflow.js && node --check zoterotabflow_prefs.js
scripts.test: npm run build:bundle && npm run guard && npm run test:syntax && npm run test:unit
